Important: HDMI over Cat6 vs HDMI over IP

These are not necessarily the same thing.

Feature

	

HDMI over Cat6 / HDBaseT

	

HDMI over IP




Typical connection

	

Direct Cat6 cable

	

Ethernet network




Standard network switch

	

Usually unsupported

Latency

	

Usually negligible

	

Depends on encoding




Video quality

	

Often uncompressed or visually lossless

	

Often compressed




Best for

	

One source to one TV

	

Multiple TVs, AV distribution

HDBaseT is generally preferable for a single long-distance HDMI connection. HDMI over IP is better for distributing video through an existing network.

Which one should you buy?

My first choice for a typical 4K home installation is the OREI UHD-EX230A-K, while the J-Tech UHDT150 is worth considering for longer professional installations. Confirm the exact supported distance at your required resolution, HDR format and chroma setting before purchasing.
